name: style-dictionary
description_en: A build system for creating cross-platform styles.
readme_excerpt: What's new in Style Dictionary 4.0! Style Dictionary See documentation > Style once, use everywhere. A Style Dictionary uses design tokens to define styles once and use those styles on any platform or language. It provides a single place to create and edit your styles, and exports these tokens to all the places you need - iOS, Android, CSS, JS, HTML, sketch files, style documentation, etc. It is available as a CLI through npm, but can also be used like any normal node module if you want to exte…
